$notes.about: Default bindings shared by the web game and the Godot scaffold. keys = KeyboardEvent.code, or Shift+code for a chord (a chord wins over the bare key's press); gamepadButtons = standard-gamepad indices (0 A, 1 B, 2 X, 3 Y, 4 LB, 5 RB, 6 LT, 7 RT, 8 Back, 9 Start, 12 D-pad up, 13 D-pad down); mouse = left / right.
$notes.axes: the four directions of the virtual steering stick
$notes.holds: held buttons read every step (look: free look — the mouse turns the head instead of steering; gamepads use the right stick, touch a second finger dragging)
$notes.presses: one-shot actions (slam: ground slam; grab: grab, then throw; front-view: the camera swings round in front of the hero to look back at the city behind)
